LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.MotorShop.Iyzico
LocaleResource.Value: Card payments through the iyzico hosted Checkout Form with server-side verification, webhooks and refunds.

LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.PaymentInfo.Payments.Iyzico
LocaleResource.Value: After placing the order you are redirected to the secure iyzico payment page. Card details are entered only there.

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction
LocaleResource.Value:
To set up iyzico:

  • Get the API key and secret key from the iyzico merchant panel (Settings / Merchant Settings). Sandbox keys come from sandbox-merchant.iyzipay.com.
  • Production: prefer the environment variables MotorShop__Iyzico__ApiKey and MotorShop__Iyzico__SecretKey. They override the keys entered here.
  • Keys entered here are encrypted with ASP.NET Core Data Protection. The data protection key folder of the tenant must be on a persistent volume, otherwise the keys must be entered again after a redeploy.
  • Enter the webhook URL below in the iyzico merchant panel and ask iyzico (entegrasyon@iyzico.com) to enable the X-IYZ-SIGNATURE-V3 header.
  • The callback URL must be reachable over HTTPS.

LocaleResource.Name: SandboxActive
LocaleResource.Value: Sandbox mode is on. No real payments are taken.

LocaleResource.Name: KeysFromConfiguration
LocaleResource.Value: API keys are provided by the server configuration (environment variables). Keys entered here are not used.

LocaleResource.Name: KeysHint
LocaleResource.Value: Keys are never displayed again after saving. Enter a new value to replace them.

LocaleResource.Name: KeysCleared
LocaleResource.Value: The stored iyzico keys have been deleted.

LocaleResource.Name: KeysAllStoresOnly
LocaleResource.Value: API keys can only be saved for all stores. Switch the store scope to "All stores" and enter them again.

LocaleResource.Name: UseSandbox.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Uses the iyzico sandbox (sandbox-api.iyzipay.com). Turn off only with production keys.

LocaleResource.Name: SecretKey.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: iyzico secret key. Stored encrypted. Also used to verify response and webhook signatures.

LocaleResource.Name: EnableInstallments.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Offers installments on the iyzico payment page. Installment commission passed on to the customer is charged by iyzico on top of the order total.

LocaleResource.Name: EnabledInstallments.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Comma separated, e.g. 1,2,3,6,9. Single payment (1) is always offered.

LocaleResource.Name: RequireWebhookSignature.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Rejects webhooks without a valid X-IYZ-SIGNATURE-V3 header. Webhooks never mark an order as paid by themselves; the result is always retrieved from iyzico first.

LocaleResource.Name: VerifyResponseSignature.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Checks the HMAC-SHA256 signature of iyzico API responses. Keep this on.

LocaleResource.Name: PlaceholderIdentityNumber
LocaleResource.Value: Buyer identity number sent to iyzico

LocaleResource.Name: PlaceholderIdentityNumber.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: iyzico requires buyer.identityNumber. The store does not collect a TCKN, so this value is sent for every buyer. Whether to collect a real TCKN is an owner decision.

LocaleResource.Name: ItemizeBasket.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Sends one basket item per order line if the lines add up to the order total. Otherwise one item for the whole order is sent.

LocaleResource.Name: BasketItemCategory.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Category sent to iyzico for basket items.

LocaleResource.Name: TryCancelOnSameDayFullRefund.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: A full refund on the payment day first tries the iyzico cancel service, which leaves no entry on the card statement. Falls back to a refund.

LocaleResource.Name: CancelUnpaidOrdersAfterHours.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Cancels iyzico orders that are still unpaid after this many hours and have no open payment attempt. Cancelling releases the reserved stock and notifies the customer. 0 turns it off.

LocaleResource.Name: AdditionalFee.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Additional fee charged to the customer for this payment method.

LocaleResource.Name: AdditionalFeePercentage.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Applies the additional fee as a percentage of the order total.

LocaleResource.Name: CallbackUrl.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Sent with every payment. iyzico posts the customer back to this URL.

LocaleResource.Name: WebhookUrl.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Enter this URL as the notification URL in the iyzico merchant panel.

LocaleResource.Name: UnsupportedCurrency
LocaleResource.Value: iyzico does not support the currency {0}.

LocaleResource.Name: NotConfigured
LocaleResource.Value: Card payment is currently not available. Please choose another payment method or contact us.

LocaleResource.Name: StartFailed
LocaleResource.Value: The payment page could not be opened. Please try again in a moment.

LocaleResource.Name: UnknownPayment
LocaleResource.Value: The payment could not be assigned to an order. If money was taken, please contact us.

LocaleResource.Name: Return.Paid
LocaleResource.Value: Thank you, your payment was received.

LocaleResource.Name: Return.InReview
LocaleResource.Value: Your payment was received and is being checked. We will ship your order once the check is complete.

LocaleResource.Name: Return.Processing
LocaleResource.Value: Your payment is being verified. This page refreshes automatically.

LocaleResource.Name: Return.Failed
LocaleResource.Value: The payment was not completed. No money was taken for this attempt. You can try again.

LocaleResource.Name: Return.SignIn
LocaleResource.Value: Sign in to see the status of your order.
